additional_info.subject: RE: ID0468466-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / SD 170004221] Outlet 2 unavailable CRM:03288000075
additional_info.body:
Good morning Mr. Duriez,
I am reaching out as Sicharge D Expert in regards of ticket
ID0468466.
The ticket has been opened form your side for outlet DC2 being unavailable on 08.01.2025 on charger MP / SD 170004221.
I analyzed the logs and took a look at the charger, and identified the issue, which is generated in the SECC.
I am escalating the topic to our R&D department, so that they can provide me with a technical solution.
In the meanwhile, please proceed to reboot the charger in case the outlet will again become out of order. It is a proven workaround to restore the availability of the charger.
I will notify you as soon as I will receive feedback and updates.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
